content:
maria: Heads-up: EU-west2 NIC has shown repeated link flaps over the last 6 hours causing ~15% increase in packet drops and sporadic GPU preemption.

maria: I want to schedule a rolling maintenance window tonight to reboot and reapply NIC firmware to affected racks. Target cohort = 10% of eu-west2 GPU pool per hour to keep latency SLOs.

maria: Proposed window: 23:00-03:00 UTC. We'll cordon/drain, reboot BMC, apply NIC fw, warm KV cache.

ops-bryan: +1. Do we have a backfill plan? Which pools are eligible for burst? :thinking:

devon: We can route burst traffic to eu-west1 and use dedicated warm nodes in eu-west2 standby. Need to preseed KV cache to avoid high 95p latency for small seq lengths.

aj: Agree. Can we avoid touching tenant-dedicated capacity during this? We have two Dedicated customers in the affected racks.

maria: We will exclude Dedicated pools and any pinned model versions. This is noisy NIC-level, not compute. We only reboot hosts in shared pools.

product-amy: Quick question: any customer-visible impact? Should we send an advisory to tenants? SLA team needs a heads up.

maria: Minimal visible impact expected if backfill works. Still sending advisory to tenants with dedicated capacity and to support. Draft comm attached below.

maria: ```
To affected tenants: We're scheduling a rolling maintenance in EU-west2 (23:00-03:00 UTC) to address intermittent network flaps. Shared capacity may see brief latency spikes; no Dedicated instances will be rebooted. Reach out to support if you see persistent errors.
``` 

infra-robin: Runbook link: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/nic-flap-rollback (runbook includes rollback and escalation steps). oncall-bot will trigger if preflight checks fail.

oncall-bot: Preflight checks scheduled at 22:15 UTC. I will post results in this thread. (bot)

ops-bryan: Cost question — if we shift burst to eu-west1 and spin up ephemeral nodes, rough cost is +$1.2k/hr. Can we cap at 2 hours?

maria: We'll do two-hour cap and use pre-warmed spot instances where possible. Estimate total cost < $3k. I'll add to the billing tracker.

devon: Reminder: run kv reseed: ```bash
k8sctl drain -l maintenance=scheduled --timeout=30m
python ops/kv_reseed.py --region eu-west2 --cohort 0.1
kubectl uncordon <node>
```

aj: I'll own tenant tagging and runtime exclusions. Posting list of pinned tenants now.

product-amy: Please post the final advisory 2 hours before start. Support will prep canned replies.

maria: Ack. Final checklist:
- Preflight @22:15 (oncall-bot)
- Tenant exclusions applied by @aj
- KV reseed by @devon
- Cost cap enforcement by @ops-bryan
- Advisory by @product-amy 21:00 UTC

maria: Any objections? :neutral_face:

infra-robin: No objections. +:thumbsup:

aj: all set from my side.

ops-bryan: Will monitor egress and post cost alerts.

oncall-bot: Preflight completed: NIC health check failed on 4/48 racks -> flagged for tonight. Logs: https://logs.redwood/abc123

maria: Thanks. Proceeding with advisory draft. Will loop in SRE for wartime channel for execution.

product-amy: Thanks team. Support on standby. :raised_hands:
